title: 科學級 CMOS 成像系統
subcategoryTitle: 天文儀器與科學感測器
summary: 從釘扎光電二極體與背照式結構出發，理解 sCMOS 為何能以 1 e⁻ 以下的讀出雜訊和 95% 的量子效率成像，再把滾動快門時序、光子轉移校正、DSNU/PRNU 校正與資料鏈路檢查整合成一套可驗收的科學相機工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Start from the pinned photodiode and back-illuminated structure to see why an sCMOS can image with sub-electron read noise and 95 percent quantum efficiency, then integrate rolling-shutter timing, photon-transfer calibration, DSNU/PRNU correction and data-link checks into an acceptable scientific-camera engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」與「滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure" and "Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 科學級 CMOS（sCMOS）的每個像素都是一個釘扎光電二極體加上四到五個電晶體：轉移閘把累積的電子送到浮動擴散節點，重置電晶體清空節點，源極隨耦器把電荷轉成電壓，列選擇電晶體把訊號送上行匯流排。量子效率 QE 是入射光子被轉成可收集電子的比例；前照式像素的金屬連線與多晶矽閘會遮擋並反射光，即使加微透鏡也只有約 60% 到 80%，背照式把晶圓薄化、從背面入光，峰值 QE 可到 95%。6.5 µm 的像素尺寸是取樣解析度與全井容量之間的折衷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every pixel of a scientific CMOS sensor is a pinned photodiode with four or five transistors: a transfer gate moves the collected electrons to a floating-diffusion node, a reset transistor empties the node, a source follower converts charge to voltage, and a row-select transistor puts the signal on the column bus. Quantum efficiency is the fraction of incident photons converted to collectable electrons; in a front-illuminated pixel the metal wiring and polysilicon gates shade and reflect light, so even with microlenses QE stays near 60 to 80 percent, whereas back-illumination thins the wafer and admits light from the rear, pushing peak QE to about 95 percent. The 6.5 µm pixel pitch is a compromise between sampling resolution and full-well capacity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：轉換增益 CG = q/C_FD。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Conversion gain is CG = q/C_FD.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要像素越小，科學相機的靈敏度就越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Smaller pixels always make a scientific camera more sensitive." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要像素越小，科學相機的靈敏度就越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure" is correct?
options: 只要像素越小，科學相機的靈敏度就越高。
科學級 CMOS（sCMOS）的每個像素都是一個釘扎光電二極體加上四到五個電晶體：轉移閘把累積的電子送到浮動擴散節點，重置電晶體清空節點，源極隨耦器把電荷轉成電壓，列選擇電晶體把訊號送上行匯流排。
滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。
optionsEn: Smaller pixels always make a scientific camera more sensitive.

A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：轉換增益 CG = q/C_FD。取浮動擴散電容 C_FD = 1.6 fF，CG = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C / 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ F = 100 µV/e⁻；全井 15,000 e⁻ 對應約 1.5 V 的節點電壓擺幅。若 100 個光子落在像素上，背照式（QE 0.95）得到 95 e⁻，前照式（QE 0.60）只有 60 e⁻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Conversion gain is CG = q/C_FD. With a floating-diffusion capacitance C_FD = 1.6 fF, CG = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C / 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ F = 100 µV per electron, so a full well of 15,000 electrons corresponds to about 1.5 V of node swing. If 100 photons land on a pixel, a back-illuminated sensor with QE 0.95 yields 95 electrons while a front-illuminated one with QE 0.60 yields only 60. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已校正的單色光源照射感測器，以 NIST 溯源的參考光電二極體量入射光子通量，把每像素平均電子數除以光子數得到各波長的 QE 曲線；再與廠商的光譜響應曲線比較，重點核對 400 nm 以下與 800 nm 以上兩端，因為背面鈍化與矽厚度的差異在這兩端最明顯。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Illuminate the sensor with a calibrated monochromatic source and measure the incident photon flux with a reference photodiode traceable to NIST; divide the mean electrons per pixel by the photon count at each wavelength to obtain the QE curve, then compare with the vendor spectral response, paying particular attention to the regions below 400 nm and above 800 nm where backside passivation and silicon thickness differ most.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 轉換增益 CG = q/C_FD。取浮動擴散電容 C_FD = 1.6 fF，CG = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C / 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ F = 100 µV/e⁻；全井 15,000 e⁻ 對應約 1.5 V 的節點電壓擺幅。若 100 個光子落在像素上，背照式（QE 0.95）得到 95 e⁻，前照式（QE 0.60）只有 60 e⁻。
knowledge.textEn: Conversion gain is CG = q/C_FD. With a floating-diffusion capacitance C_FD = 1.6 fF, CG = 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C / 1.6×10⁻¹⁵ F = 100 µV per electron, so a full well of 15,000 electrons corresponds to about 1.5 V of node swing. If 100 photons land on a pixel, a back-illuminated sensor with QE 0.95 yields 95 electrons while a front-illuminated one with QE 0.60 yields only 60.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure", which statement holds?
options: 矽層越厚，任何波長的量子效率都越高，沒有代價。
固定圖樣雜訊只要多拍幾張平均就會消失。
轉換增益 CG = q/C_FD。
optionsEn: Thicker silicon raises quantum efficiency at every wavelength with no penalty.
Fixed-pattern noise disappears if enough frames are averaged.
Conversion gain is CG = q/C_FD.
quiz.explanation: 轉換增益 CG = q/C_FD。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Conversion gain is CG = q/C_FD. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用已校正的單色光源照射感測器，以 NIST 溯源的參考光電二極體量入射光子通量，把每像素平均電子數除以光子數得到各波長的 QE 曲線；再與廠商的光譜響應曲線比較，重點核對 400 nm 以下與 800 nm 以上兩端，因為背面鈍化與矽厚度的差異在這兩端最明顯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Illuminate the sensor with a calibrated monochromatic source and measure the incident photon flux with a reference photodiode traceable to NIST; divide the mean electrons per pixel by the photon count at each wavelength to obtain the QE curve, then compare with the vendor spectral response, paying particular attention to the regions below 400 nm and above 800 nm where backside passivation and silicon thickness differ most. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Poor backside passivation lets surface states trap the electrons generated by short wavelengths, so blue and ultraviolet QE collapses and drifts with temperature and illumination history; images look normal but quantitative fluorescence ratios shift over time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用已校正的單色光源照射感測器，以 NIST 溯源的參考光電二極體量入射光子通量，把每像素平均電子數除以光子數得到各波長的 QE 曲線；再與廠商的光譜響應曲線比較，重點核對 400 nm 以下與 800 nm 以上兩端，因為背面鈍化與矽厚度的差異在這兩端最明顯。
knowledge.textEn: Illuminate the sensor with a calibrated monochromatic source and measure the incident photon flux with a reference photodiode traceable to NIST; divide the mean electrons per pixel by the photon count at each wavelength to obtain the QE curve, then compare with the vendor spectral response, paying particular attention to the regions below 400 nm and above 800 nm where backside passivation and silicon thickness differ most.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure"?
options: 用已校正的單色光源照射感測器，以 NIST 溯源的參考光電二極體量入射光子通量，把每像素平均電子數除以光子數得到各波長的 QE 曲線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
放大率越高，影像解析度一定越好。
optionsEn: Illuminate the sensor with a calibrated monochromatic source and measure the incident photon flux with a reference photodiode traceable to NIST.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher magnification always gives better image resolution.
quiz.explanation: 用已校正的單色光源照射感測器，以 NIST 溯源的參考光電二極體量入射光子通量，把每像素平均電子數除以光子數得到各波長的 QE 曲線；再與廠商的光譜響應曲線比較，重點核對 400 nm 以下與 800 nm 以上兩端，因為背面鈍化與矽厚度的差異在這兩端最明顯。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Illuminate the sensor with a calibrated monochromatic source and measure the incident photon flux with a reference photodiode traceable to NIST; divide the mean electrons per pixel by the photon count at each wavelength to obtain the QE curve, then compare with the vendor spectral response, paying particular attention to the regions below 400 nm and above 800 nm where backside passivation and silicon thickness differ most. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Poor backside passivation lets surface states trap the electrons generated by short wavelengths, so blue and ultraviolet QE collapses and drifts with temperature and illumination history; images look normal but quantitative fluorescence ratios shift over time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：6.5 µm 的像素尺寸是取樣解析度與全井容量之間的折衷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The 6.5 µm pixel pitch is a compromise between sampling resolution and full-well capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要像素越小，科學相機的靈敏度就越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Smaller pixels always make a scientific camera more sensitive." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。
knowledge.textEn: Poor backside passivation lets surface states trap the electrons generated by short wavelengths, so blue and ultraviolet QE collapses and drifts with temperature and illumination history; images look normal but quantitative fluorescence ratios shift over time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「光子到電子：量子效率與像素結構」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Photons to electrons: quantum efficiency and pixel structure" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。
滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Poor backside passivation lets surface states trap the electrons generated by short wavelengths, so blue and ultraviolet QE collapses and drifts with temperature and illumination history.
A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time.
quiz.explanation: 背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor backside passivation lets surface states trap the electrons generated by short wavelengths, so blue and ultraviolet QE collapses and drifts with temperature and illumination history; images look normal but quantitative fluorescence ratios shift over time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「滾動快門時序圖」如何決定科學級 CMOS 成像系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rolling-shutter timing diagram” determines the key performance of “Scientific CMOS imaging systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。移動物體會被剪切變形，脈衝照明會在畫面上留下亮暗條帶。全域快門讓所有像素同時開始與結束曝光，但需要在像素內增加一個儲存節點與遮光結構，讀出雜訊通常高於滾動模式（例如 2.3 e⁻ 對 0.9 e⁻），填充因子也較低。許多 sCMOS 提供全域重置或光片讀出模式，用時序而非像素結構解決同時性問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「滾動快門時序圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line. Moving objects shear and pulsed illumination leaves bright and dark bands across the frame. A global shutter starts and stops exposure for all pixels at once but needs an in-pixel storage node and light shield, so read noise is usually higher than in rolling mode (for example 2.3 versus 0.9 electrons) and the fill factor is lower. Many sCMOS cameras offer a global-reset or light-sheet readout mode that solves simultaneity with timing rather than pixel structure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rolling-shutter timing diagram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「滾動快門時序圖」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Rolling-shutter timing diagram”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何
knowledge.titleEn: Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry
knowledge.text: sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。移動物體會被剪切變形，脈衝照明會在畫面上留下亮暗條帶。
knowledge.textEn: Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line. Moving objects shear and pulsed illumination leaves bright and dark bands across the frame.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry" is correct?
options: 滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。
讀出雜訊是感測器的固定常數，與讀出速度無關。
sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。
optionsEn: A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time.
Read noise is a fixed constant of the sensor, independent of readout speed.

Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line.
quiz.explanation: sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滾動快門時序圖」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rolling-shutter timing diagram” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。取 2048 列、t_line = 10 µs，偏斜 = 20.48 ms。若曝光 t_exp = 30 ms，所有列同時開啟的窗口 = t_exp − 偏斜 = 9.52 ms，脈衝照明必須落在這 9.52 ms 內才不會產生條帶；若 t_exp 只有 5 ms，則不存在同時窗口，必須改用全域快門或全域重置。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Frame skew = N_rows×t_line. For 2048 rows and t_line = 10 µs the skew is 20.48 ms. With an exposure t_exp = 30 ms the window in which every row is open at once is t_exp − skew = 9.52 ms, so a light pulse must fall inside those 9.52 ms to avoid banding; with t_exp = 5 ms no common window exists and a global shutter or global-reset mode is required. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜；再把閃爍時刻掃過整個曝光，確認同時開啟窗口的長度與計算值一致，並對照相機輸出的曝光結束觸發訊號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated; from the number of bright rows deduce t_line and the skew, then sweep the flash across the whole exposure to confirm that the length of the common open window matches the calculation and lines up with the camera's exposure-end trigger output.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。取 2048 列、t_line = 10 µs，偏斜 = 20.48 ms。若曝光 t_exp = 30 ms，所有列同時開啟的窗口 = t_exp − 偏斜 = 9.52 ms，脈衝照明必須落在這 9.52 ms 內才不會產生條帶；若 t_exp 只有 5 ms，則不存在同時窗口，必須改用全域快門或全域重置。
knowledge.textEn: Frame skew = N_rows×t_line. For 2048 rows and t_line = 10 µs the skew is 20.48 ms. With an exposure t_exp = 30 ms the window in which every row is open at once is t_exp − skew = 9.52 ms, so a light pulse must fall inside those 9.52 ms to avoid banding; with t_exp = 5 ms no common window exists and a global shutter or global-reset mode is required.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry", which statement holds?
options: 畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。
感測器的增益可以直接從位元深度算出，不需要量測。
放大率越高，影像解析度一定越好。
optionsEn: Frame skew = N_rows×t_line.
A sensor's gain can be derived from its bit depth without measurement.
Higher magnification always gives better image resolution.
quiz.explanation: 畫面偏斜 = N_rows×t_line。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Frame skew = N_rows×t_line. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「滾動快門時序圖」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Rolling-shutter timing diagram” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜；再把閃爍時刻掃過整個曝光，確認同時開啟窗口的長度與計算值一致，並對照相機輸出的曝光結束觸發訊號。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated; from the number of bright rows deduce t_line and the skew, then sweep the flash across the whole exposure to confirm that the length of the common open window matches the calculation and lines up with the camera's exposure-end trigger output. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape; downstream particle tracking or deformation measurement then carries a systematic bias that no dark or flat correction can remove.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜；再把閃爍時刻掃過整個曝光，確認同時開啟窗口的長度與計算值一致，並對照相機輸出的曝光結束觸發訊號。
knowledge.textEn: Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated; from the number of bright rows deduce t_line and the skew, then sweep the flash across the whole exposure to confirm that the length of the common open window matches the calculation and lines up with the camera's exposure-end trigger output.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜。
相機資料表上的規格就是驗收標準，不需要自己量測。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated.
Datasheet specifications are the acceptance criteria and need no in-house measurement.
quiz.explanation: 用一顆 LED 以 100 µs 的脈衝在曝光期間不同時刻閃爍，記錄哪些列被照亮，從亮帶的列數反推 t_line 與偏斜；再把閃爍時刻掃過整個曝光，確認同時開啟窗口的長度與計算值一致，並對照相機輸出的曝光結束觸發訊號。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Flash an LED for 100 µs at different moments during the exposure and record which rows are illuminated; from the number of bright rows deduce t_line and the skew, then sweep the flash across the whole exposure to confirm that the length of the common open window matches the calculation and lines up with the camera's exposure-end trigger output. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滾動快門時序圖」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Rolling-shutter timing diagram” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape; downstream particle tracking or deformation measurement then carries a systematic bias that no dark or flat correction can remove. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：許多 sCMOS 提供全域重置或光片讀出模式，用時序而非像素結構解決同時性問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Many sCMOS cameras offer a global-reset or light-sheet readout mode that solves simultaneity with timing rather than pixel structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滾動快門代表畫面上每一列的曝光時間都不一樣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A rolling shutter means each row receives a different exposure time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。
knowledge.textEn: Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape; downstream particle tracking or deformation measurement then carries a systematic bias that no dark or flat correction can remove.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「滾動快門與全域快門的曝光幾何」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rolling versus global shutter exposure geometry" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
讀出雜訊是感測器的固定常數，與讀出速度無關。
若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Read noise is a fixed constant of the sensor, independent of readout speed.
Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape.
quiz.explanation: 若用滾動快門拍攝旋轉或快速平移的目標，影像會出現剪切與形狀失真，後續的粒子追蹤或形變量測會得到系統性偏差，而且這種誤差無法用平場或暗場校正移除。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Imaging a rotating or fast-translating target with a rolling shutter shears the object and distorts its shape; downstream particle tracking or deformation measurement then carries a systematic bias that no dark or flat correction can remove. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
